label: AI Services
title: Put AI where the work actually happens.
intro: We find the process worth fixing, build AI into the systems you already run, and stay until it holds up in production. Then it runs without us.

sections.title: A request is rarely one task
sections.label: One request, five steps
intro: A customer changes a delivery date. That means checking the order, finding a new slot, following policy, updating dispatch, and confirming the change.
We connect the steps that get the whole job done.

blocks.title: Customer request
body: “Can we move Thursday’s delivery to Monday?”

blocks.title: Check availability
body: Order #48213 found. Two Monday slots open.

blocks.title: Apply rules
body: Free change inside 48 hours. No fee applies.

blocks.title: Update systems
body: ERP order moved. Dispatch route rebuilt.

blocks.title: Confirm
body: Text and email sent. Record closed.

sections.title: You see it work before you run it
sections.label: Our approach
intro: We build in your environment, test on your real cases, and measure quality, speed, and cost before anything goes live.

blocks.title: Find the workflow worth improving
body: We sit with the people doing the work, measure where time and cost go, and agree on the one process to start with.
blocks.label: Understand

blocks.title: Map the data, decisions, and controls
body: Which systems hold the context, which decisions AI can make, and which need a person. The controls are designed before the first line of code.
blocks.label: Design

blocks.title: Develop and integrate the solution
body: We build in your environment and connect your systems, so what we test is what you will run.
blocks.label: Build

blocks.title: Test performance against agreed targets
body: Real scenarios, measured for quality, speed, and cost against the targets we set in step one. Nothing goes live on a demo.
blocks.label: Validate
